description: TAXSIM imputes the sales-tax deduction from IRS Pub. 600 regressions; we use as-reported salt_inc_sales
TAXSIM state law 2021+ is inflated ~2020 law, not enacted law; cells in this window are non-canonical (PolicyEngine is the tie-breaker)

TAXSIM-35 has no tax-exempt interest input, so it can never apply state exempt-interest addbacks (or count exempt_int in the federal EITC investment-income test); records with exempt_int > 0 are outside the clean-subset metrics
expected_magnitude: dollar-for-dollar times state rate for addback states
source: IL 2019 diagnosis 2026-07-18 (cor 0.92 of state-AGI gap with exempt_int)

description: TAXSIM-35 has no state-refund input, so state-mode crosswalk omits state_ref entirely (states subtract their own refunds); TAXSIM federal AGI runs low by state_ref, handled inside the fed_aligned flag
expected_magnitude: zero at the state level by construction
source: IL 2019 diagnosis 2026-07-18 (cor 1.00 of clean state-AGI gap with state_ref before the fix)

description: State EITCs piggyback on federal EITC; TAXSIM's own federal EITC (amount and eligibility) can differ from ours, propagating scaled differences into state EITC; clean-subset metrics condition on federal EITC agreement
expected_magnitude: state EITC percentage times federal EITC gap
